profiles.settings: CUDA float16, English, beam_size=4, patience=1.0, length_penalty=1.0; Silero VAD on, threshold=0.30, min_silence_duration_ms=1000, speech_pad_ms=400; log_prob_threshold=-1.0, no_speech_threshold=0.3, compression_ratio_threshold=2.4; no initial prompt or hotwords, word_timestamps=false. BatchedInferencePipeline batch_size=2 at duration >=60 s, ordinary sequential WhisperModel below 60 s.

profiles.settings: CUDA BF16 (FP16 fallback), 16 kHz mono channel 0, batch_size=1, greedy_batch, max_symbols_per_step=10, loop_labels=true, CUDA graph decoder=true; VAD threshold=0.30, minimum speech=150 ms, silence=700 ms, padding=400 ms; trim outer edges only, preserve internal pauses, max segment=120 s, overlap=0. No phrase file for generic benchmarks; word timestamps enabled.
profiles.notes: Word confidence was initially enabled; the final consensus worker disables it because of a NeMo metadata failure. Keep the model/cache resident; free unused cache for OOM recovery, not after every successful request.

profiles.settings: Earlier greedy accuracy preset: P120 decoder and VAD values, but max segment=25 s, forced overlap=2 s; programming phrase file, alpha=0.5, context_score=1.0, depth_scaling=2.0; timestamps/confidence on.
profiles.notes: The short technical test exposed duplicate/corrupted words in the overlap merger. Not the corrected P120 benchmark.

profiles.settings: Earlier accuracy preset: CUDA BF16, malsd_batch beam=5, batch=1, max_symbols_per_step=10, CUDA graphs off; VAD 0.30 / 150 ms speech / 1000 ms silence / 400 ms pad; 25 s segments, 2 s overlap; no active phrase file, configured alpha=1.5 therefore inactive; timestamps/confidence off; empty_cache after requests.
profiles.notes: Superseded; setting alpha without loading phrases does not activate boosting.

profiles.settings: Q8_0 language weights, FP16 speech projector, context=4096, one slot, automatic GPU layer offload; channel 0 mono 16 kHz PCM16; temperature=0, max_tokens=512; prompt='transcribe the speech with proper punctuation and capitalization.'; seven non-overlapping 90 s chunks on R332; no keywords.
profiles.notes: Earlier live configuration used Vulkan and 2048 tokens without explicit temperature. Those settings are not the GQ scored benchmark. Prompt must be sent per chunk.

profiles.settings: CUDA BF16, eval/inference mode, do_sample=false, num_beams=1, max_new_tokens=512; 16 kHz mono, same seven 90 s chunks and punctuation-only prompt as GQ; no keywords.
profiles.notes: Native-runtime control, not Q8.

profiles.settings: CUDA BF16, eval/inference mode, 16 kHz mono, English forced, no context/glossary, deterministic generation, max_new_tokens=512, independent 90 s chunks.
profiles.notes: Q60 changes only chunk duration to 60 s.

profiles.settings: Q90 with 60 s chunks.
profiles.notes: No post-processing for raw WER.

profiles.settings: 30 s chunks, stride=26 s, max_new_tokens=256, word_timestamps=false; verbatim/intended mode and continuation/chunked_lcs strategy as specified per row. Continuation: context_words=12, drop_words=2, temperature fallback on, speculative decoding off, hallucination mitigation on.
profiles.notes: Continuation dropped large portions of this sample. Verbatim mode is additionally mismatched to a cleaned publisher reference. Not all low-level runtime defaults were retained.

profiles.settings: CUDA BF16, English, punctuation on, greedy, max_new_tokens=256, 16 kHz mono, VAD; independent fixed 35 s blocks, one at a time (18 blocks for R332).
profiles.notes: Initial memory workaround. It is NOT the later official-boundary control.

profiles.settings: BF16, English, punctuation=true, greedy deterministic generation, max_new_tokens=256; 16 kHz mono, edge-only Silero VAD; complete waveform through official CPU processor, max_audio_clip_s=35 and backward low-energy search window=5 s; GPU microbatch=1, preserve attention_mask, decoder_input_ids, audio_chunk_index; ordered reassembly.
profiles.notes: The 5 s search window is not duplicated overlapping audio. R332 yields 19 official chunks. Recorded generation-only timings exclude CPU processor time.

profiles.model: Whisper large-v3 + Cohere Transcribe + Parakeet TDT v2
profiles.runtime: Isolated sequential voters, deterministic ROVER merge
profiles.settings: W4 + C-OFFICIAL + unboosted P120; strict three-way word/punctuation majority, Whisper tie-breaking anchor; no reference, LLM, glossary, or confidence score used to merge.
profiles.notes: Model loads are repeated in separate processes; cold pipeline duration is not comparable to one resident model's warm duration.

profiles.model: Whisper large-v3 + Parakeet TDT v2 + selective Cohere
profiles.settings: Full W4 and P120 passes, merge timestamped disagreement regions, run one C-OFFICIAL worker on those regions only, three-way voting inside regions and Whisper elsewhere.
profiles.notes: Not the proposed inverse cascade of full Cohere with selective Whisper fallback.

profiles.settings: Initial CPU-loaded path, then explicit CUDA placement; complete settings and comparable quality benchmark not retained.
profiles.notes: CPU transcription worked slowly; subsequent CUDA transfer ran out of memory. Not evidence of a clean under-5-GiB run.

profiles.settings: Whole R332 recording, punctuation request; architecture-specific Q8 path.
profiles.notes: Repetition failure and 5716 MiB sampled driver memory. No completed WER/punctuation score recovered.

profiles.settings: Restore punctuation on the earlier 65-error Whisper transcript.
profiles.notes: Exact FullStop checkpoint and extra processing duration not recovered; do not assume lexical WER is a new ASR run.

profiles.settings: At least 5 active speech frames; sub-60 Hz energy >= -35 dBFS AND (low-frequency ratio >=0.25 OR absolute DC offset >=0.005); if triggered, mono WAV with a two-pole 80 Hz high-pass. Preserve original and fail open.
profiles.notes: Source-signal measurements and transcript equality checks, not reference-scored WER tests.

profiles.settings: No completed local parameter/result pairing was recovered.
profiles.notes: A suggestion or configured option is not a benchmark.

profiles.settings: W4 audio/decoder values, but ordinary sequential decoding for the entire long file. The two official-style controls also set beam=5 and no_speech_threshold=0.6; external VAD on/off is specified per row.
profiles.notes: Sequential context, temperature fallback and timestamp-window behavior differ from batching. The controls did not establish that sequential decoding improves this corpus.

experiments.label: Further Cohere controls

experiments.label: Cohere-first selective Whisper cascade

experiments.label: LLM transcript/punctuation rewriting, fine-tuning, external LM

experiments.label: Generic gain boost, band-pass, denoising or compression
experiments.notes: Discussed as possibilities; no representative-corpus WER win was demonstrated. Only the specific gain/mount/high-pass experiments above have retained local evidence.

prompts.whisper_style: Produce a verbatim English transcript with professional capitalization and punctuation. Use commas, periods, and question marks where natural.
prompts.granite_raw: can you transcribe the speech into a written format?
prompts.granite_punctuation: transcribe the speech with proper punctuation and capitalization.
prompts.granite_keyword_note: Append Keywords: followed by canonical terms separated by commas; programming identifiers used on TECH32 must not be treated as a neutral podcast prompt.
